text_markup: The Runner spends the credit hosted on {card:Cyberfeeder} to pay the trigger cost of {card:Mimic}'s ability. Because the Runner triggered {card:Mimic}'s paid ability and {card:Cyberfeeder}'s ability allowed the credit to be spent, both {card:Mimic} and {card:Cyberfeeder} have been used.
text_plain: The Runner spends the credit hosted on Cyberfeeder to pay the trigger cost of Mimic's ability. Because the Runner triggered Mimic's paid ability and Cyberfeeder's ability allowed the credit to be spent, both Mimic and Cyberfeeder have been used.
